about.title: About
about.description: Valerio Colapinto, Electronic Engineering student at Sapienza: why and how I write these study sites.
about.h1b: I build the tools I study with.
about.lead: Electronic Engineering student at Sapienza, graduating in 2028. I am interested in electronics, telecommunications and computer science.
about.facts.title: At a glance
about.f4.v: Interactive study tools, free and tracking-free
about.how.title: Understand from scratch, then verify
about.how.p: These sites come from the way I like to study: understand things from scratch, check them with exercises and simulations, and build the tools I need.
about.s1.d: I start from definitions and proofs, not from formulas to memorise.
about.s2.d: Where possible, every exercise has a computed solution checked with a second method, so the result can be trusted.
about.s3.d: If a tool does not exist, I write it: exercise generators, mock-exam simulators, formula sheets.
about.work.title: Git, GitHub and an AI assistant
about.work.p: I develop with Git and GitHub and with the help of artificial intelligence. The code is public and, where possible, the content is verified with automated tests.
about.pr.title: What you will find here (and what not)
about.p1.d: Explanations, exercises and quizzes are original: no exam texts or professors' materials.
about.p2.d: No accounts, cookies or analytics: your progress stays in your browser.
about.p3.d: The code is public on GitHub under the MIT licence.
about.p4.d: They are not affiliated with any university or professor: for syllabus and exams, official sources prevail.
about.ct.title: Contact
about.ct.sub: For questions, errors you found on the sites or content removal requests, email is the most direct channel.

cf.introOnline: Your message goes straight to the person who maintains the site. Every contribution is read; if it is correct, the page is updated.
cf.introOffline: Fill in the form: it will prepare a ready-to-send email in your mail app.
cf.typeHint.errore: A wrong formula, step, solution or link.
cf.typeHint.miglioria: A clearer explanation, a missing exercise, a useful feature.
cf.typeHint.appunti: Notes, diagrams or worked exercises written by you, to be added to the site.
cf.pageHint: Optional. Filled in automatically when you come from “Report an error”.
cf.messageHint: Point to the exact step and say what you expected.
cf.placeholder.errore: E.g.: in exercise 3 the result is 2.4 mA, not 24 mA, because…
cf.placeholder.miglioria: E.g.: a numerical example after the definition of … would help.
cf.placeholder.appunti: Describe the material you attach and which topics it covers.
cf.filesHint: Optional: up to {files} files, {size} in total. PDF, images (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, HEIC), TXT, Markdown, LaTeX, DOCX, ODT. No ZIP archives.
cf.filesOffline: The email cannot include attachments by itself: add them by hand before sending it.
cf.emailHint: Optional: only if you want a reply. It is never published.
cf.nameHint: Optional: if the contribution is accepted, it will appear on the Acknowledgements page.
cf.consent.consensoPrivacy: I have read the privacy notice and agree to the processing of the data I send in order to handle the contribution.
cf.consent.consensoDiritti: The material is mine or freely reusable: it contains no lecture notes, slides, books or exam papers by lecturers, nor other third-party protected material.
cf.consent.consensoPubblicazione: I agree that the contribution, possibly reworked, may be published on the site under its licence, with my name in the acknowledgements if I gave one.
cf.err.pagina.invalid: must be an address of this site starting with “/”.
cf.err.consensoPrivacy.required: consent is needed to handle the contribution.
cf.err.consensoDiritti.required: confirm that the material can be reused.
cf.err.consensoPubblicazione.required: consent is needed to include the contribution.

home.eyebrow: Electronic Engineering · a personal, unofficial project
home.offer.title: What you will find
home.offer.theory.title: Layered theory
home.offer.theory.text: Each topic goes from intuition to formalism, with worked examples and typical mistakes; formulas rendered with KaTeX and a printable formula sheet.
home.offer.exercises.title: Exercises with grading
home.offer.exercises.text: Numerical answers with units and tolerance, hints and step-by-step solutions; many exercises generate new variants on every attempt.
home.offer.review.title: Spaced review
home.offer.review.text: Flashcards scheduled with FSRS, merged into a single queue across courses and tuned to your exam date.
home.offer.exam.title: Mock exams
home.offer.exam.text: Tests with the structure of the real exam, a timer, a grade and an analysis of weak topics; printable, with solutions on separate pages.
home.offer.offline.title: Search and offline
home.offer.offline.text: Search theory, formulas, exercises and flashcards of every course (press /); install the site and download courses to study without a connection.
home.offer.data.title: Your data stays yours
home.offer.data.text: No accounts and no analytics: progress and notes stay in your browser and move between devices with a file or a QR code.
home.about.title: Who is behind it
home.about.text: These sites grew out of the notes of an Electronic Engineering student and improve with the reports of the people who use them. If you find an error or want to suggest content, get in touch: every contribution is read.
